about1: While admin.dualControl is on, the high-risk acts the second tab lists are not done when an administrator asks: each waits here until a second, different administrator holding the same authority approves it, when it runs as the first one's act, or refuses it. Whoever asked may withdraw it; undecided, it expires after admin.dualControlLifetimeHours.
about2: When fewer than two people could decide an act, it runs at once and the audit log says nobody approved it, so that a realm can never be locked out. Turn the setting on or off on Admin roles; turning it off is itself held.
empty: Nothing is held in this realm.
tableLead: Each row is one management API operation. Where only some bodies of it are high-risk (an administrator role, a CA certificate, the setting turned off), only those are held.
